title: 高市外交に「弱腰」批判 ICC、ロシア対応巡り
titleTranslation: Takaichi diplomacy criticized as 'weak-kneed' over ICC, Russia response
summary: The Takaichi administration is facing domestic criticism for its timid response to U.S. sanctions on ICC President Akane Tomoko and to Putin's visit to the Northern Territories, largely out of concern for relations with the U.S. and Japan's energy supply from Russia.

sentences.text: 米国による国際刑事裁判所の赤根智子所長への制裁や、プーチン・ロシア大統領の北方領土訪問を巡り、政権の対応は「弱腰」だとの批判が出ている。

tokens.reading: こくさいけいじさいばんしょ

sentences.translation: Criticism has emerged that the administration's response is 'weak-kneed' regarding U.S. sanctions on ICC President Akane Tomoko and Russian President Putin's visit to the Northern Territories.

sentences.text: ICC問題では唯一の同盟国に気兼ねして非難や抗議をせず、高市早苗首相が「残念」と言及しただけ。

tokens.gloss: reserve, hesitation out of consideration for others

sentences.translation: On the ICC issue, out of deference to its sole ally, Japan has not criticized or protested, with Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae only calling it 'regrettable.'

sentences.text: 対ロ外交でもエネルギー供給への影響を懸念して、対抗措置を打ち出せずにいるためだ。

tokens.gloss: to be able to put forward/announce (potential of 打ち出す)
because of, for the sake of

sentences.translation: This is because, in its diplomacy toward Russia as well, concern over the impact on energy supply has kept the government from announcing countermeasures.

sentences.text: 自民党本部で21日開かれた外交部会などの合同会議。
sentences.translation: A joint meeting of the diplomacy division and other panels was held at LDP headquarters on the 21st.

sentences.text: 出席者からは「米国に制裁撤回を求めるべきだ」「赤根氏を守らないといけない」と政府への不満が続出した。

tokens.gloss: must, have to (from いけない 'must not')

sentences.translation: Attendees repeatedly voiced frustration with the government, saying things like 'We should demand the U.S. rescind the sanctions' and 'We must protect Ms. Akane.'

sentences.text: 「法の支配」を重視する日本は、ICC分担金の最大拠出国。
sentences.translation: Japan, which values the 'rule of law,' is the largest contributor to the ICC's budget.

sentences.text: 首相は1月、日本人初の所長を務める赤根氏と首相官邸で会談し「力強い支援」を約束した経緯がある。

tokens.gloss: to serve as, hold the post of

sentences.translation: In January, the Prime Minister met at the Prime Minister's Office with Ms. Akane, the first Japanese national to serve as ICC President, and promised 'strong support.'

sentences.text: だが、19日早朝に赤根氏が制裁対象に指定されたとの報道が駆け巡っても、政府の動きは鈍かった。
sentences.translation: But even after reports spread early on the morning of the 19th that Ms. Akane had been named a sanctions target, the government's response was slow.

sentences.text: 首相がようやく口を開いたのは午後6時すぎ。
sentences.translation: It was not until just after 6 p.m. that the Prime Minister finally spoke.

sentences.text: 「大変残念に思っている」と述べ、ICCへの支援や米国への抗議は一切口にしなかった。
sentences.translation: She said, 'I find this extremely regrettable,' but made no mention whatsoever of support for the ICC or protest toward the United States.

sentences.text: 欧州各国が赤根氏らへの支持を続々と表明したのとは対照的だ。
sentences.translation: This stood in contrast to European countries, which one after another expressed support for Ms. Akane and others.

sentences.text: 閣僚経験者は「首相の発信は全然足りない」と指摘。
sentences.translation: A former cabinet minister pointed out, 'The Prime Minister's messaging is nowhere near enough.'

sentences.text: 国際人権団体アムネスティ・インターナショナルのカラマール事務総長はXで、日本政府の発信について「かなり弱い」と嘆いた。

tokens.surface: アムネスティ・インターナショナル

tokens.gloss: to attach/be attached (base of について 'regarding')

sentences.translation: Agnès Callamard, Secretary General of the international human rights group Amnesty International, lamented on X that the Japanese government's messaging was 'quite weak.'

sentences.text: プーチン氏の北方領土訪問では、首相は「中長期的な関係回復を困難にした」と即座に反発。
sentences.translation: Regarding Putin's visit to the Northern Territories, the Prime Minister immediately pushed back, saying it 'made medium- to long-term restoration of relations difficult.'

sentences.text: 外務省は駐日大使を呼んで抗議した。

tokens.gloss: resident in Japan (as in ambassador to Japan)

sentences.translation: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned the Russian ambassador to Japan and lodged a protest.

sentences.text: 政府は「次の一手」として経済制裁の強化や武藤顕駐ロ大使の一時帰国を選択肢として検討するが、1週間が経過しても対応は定まらない。

tokens.gloss: stationed at, resident (prefix, as in 駐ロ)

sentences.translation: As a 'next move,' the government is weighing options such as strengthening economic sanctions and temporarily recalling Ambassador to Russia Muto Akira, but even after a week has passed, no course of action has been decided.

sentences.text: ロシア・サハリンからの液化天然ガス輸入に影響を及ぼしかねないためだ。

tokens.gloss: might well, cannot (as in 及ぼしかねない)
because of, for the sake of

sentences.translation: This is because it could affect imports of liquefied natural gas from Sakhalin, Russia.

sentences.text: 政府内からは「エネルギー問題は考慮せざるを得ない」との声が上がる。
sentences.translation: Voices within the government say, 'We have no choice but to take the energy issue into consideration.'

sentences.text: 茂木敏充外相は20日の記者会見で、対抗策について問われ「日本の国益にとって何が必要か総合的に勘案しながら適切に対応する」。

tokens.gloss: to attach/be attached (base of について 'regarding')
to take (base of にとって 'for, from the standpoint of')

sentences.translation: Foreign Minister Motegi Toshimitsu, asked about countermeasures at a press conference on the 20th, said only, 'We will respond appropriately while comprehensively weighing what is necessary for Japan's national interest.'

sentences.text: 木原稔官房長官も記者団に「政府内で検討している」と述べるにとどめた。
sentences.translation: Chief Cabinet Secretary Kihara Minoru likewise told reporters only that 'it is being considered within the government.'

sentences.text: 国民民主党の玉木雄一郎代表は18日の会見で「政権の姿勢は弱腰に過ぎる」と断じた。

tokens.reading: こくみんみんしゅとう

sentences.translation: Democratic Party for the People leader Tamaki Yuichiro declared at a press conference on the 18th that 'the administration's stance is far too weak-kneed.'
